name: UNCLEAN MEMORIES
source:
"Klin," a self-aware weapon, survives with the help of a mysterious cyborg girl named "Michelle."

On a journey with Michelle to find his creator, memories of the past and the image of an unknown girl surface.

"In a past stained with blood, does a weapon dream of the nightmare of humanity?"
